citizenScience.title: Citizen Science Project
citizenScience.description: This app is part of an open-source, open-data, open-science Citizen Science participatory sensing project for collecting anonymized traffic trajectory data.

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.description: We collect sensor data (accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer) continuously and GPS data when online. All data is stored locally on your device and only uploaded with your explicit consent.

privacy.title: Privacy & Anonymity
privacy.description: No personal identifiers are collected. All data is completely anonymous and cannot be traced back to you. No authentication or login is required.

openData.title: Open Data Philosophy
openData.description: Collected data will be made available following FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) principles for scientific research and public benefit.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.description: You can stop data collection at any time. You choose whether to upload your data after each ride. You can delete local data from your device at any time.

vehicle.title: Select your vehicle
vehicle.description: Choose a mode of transport below. You can edit the list by tapping the settings icon.
vehicle.lowStorage: Low storage: {freeMB} MB available. Recording may stop if storage runs out.
vehicle.manageDescription: Toggle which vehicle types are visible on the selection screen.

record.description: Recording includes accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer (continuous), and GPS only while online. Data is stored locally as CSV during the ride. You will choose to upload after stopping.
record.recordingDescription: The UI is minimized to reduce resource usage.
record.stopConfirmMessage: Are you sure you want to stop?
record.uploadMessage: Would you like to upload your CSV data now? You can also share or save it.
record.notReady: Sensors or storage are not available. Please try again.
record.failedToStartMessage: An error occurred while starting recording.
record.rideCompleteMessage: Your ride data has been saved locally. Would you like to see a summary of your ride?
record.backgroundGpsDescription: Keep tracking GPS when app is in background

feedback.title: Ride Summary
feedback.description: Here's a simple analysis of your ride data processed locally on your device.
feedback.noData: No ride data available for analysis.
feedback.disclaimer: This analysis is performed entirely on your device. No data is sent anywhere for this summary.
feedback.localFeedbackMessage: Show a simple, visual-only summary from your collected data on-device?
